ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a honeycomb-like connected network composed of circles and line segments, with a total of 24 circles. A circle near the upper middle has 7 written in it, and a circle at the lower left has 4 written in it. Each line segment connects two adjacent circles. Reasoning: Let the common sum of the numbers at the two ends of each line segment be S. If a certain circle contains x, then all circles adjacent to it must be S−x; and circles two edges farther outward must again be x. Therefore the entire connected network, according to parity of distance, can only alternately contain two numbers. From the alternating coloring along the line segments in the figure, it can be seen that the circle containing 7 and the circle containing 4 are in opposite parity classes, so the sum of this pair of numbers in the adjacent sense is S, namely S=7+4=11. Therefore all circles in the same class as 7 are filled with 7, and all circles in the same class as 4 are filled with 4. Counting alternately according to the figure, the two classes each have 12 circles, so the total sum is 12×7+12×4=12×11=132.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a connected network of 24 circles arranged like a honeycomb strip, with a 7 in the upper near-center circle and a 4 in a lower-left circle. Use the condition that every connected pair has the same endpoint sum, say S. Starting from any circle labeled x, every neighbor must be S - x, and every circle two steps away must again be x, so the labels alternate by graph-distance parity. From the image, the given 7 and 4 lie in opposite parity classes of the network, so S = 7 + 4 = 11. Therefore every circle in the 7-parity class is 7 and every circle in the 4-parity class is 4. Count the circles by alternating/coloring the network from the image: there are 12 circles in each parity class. The total is 12*7 + 12*4 = 12*(11) = 132.

图像描述：图中是一个由圆圈和线段组成的蜂窝状连通网络，共有24个圆圈。上方靠中间的一个圆圈中写有7，左下方的一个圆圈中写有4。每条线段连接两个相邻圆圈。

推理：设每条线段两端数字的相同和为S。如果某个圆圈中是x，那么与它相邻的所有圆圈都必须是S−x；再往外相隔两条边的圆圈又必须是x。因此整个连通网络按距离奇偶性只会交替出现两种数。由图中沿线段交替着色可见，7所在圆圈和4所在圆圈在相反的奇偶类中，所以它们相邻意义下的一对数之和就是S，即S=7+4=11。因此与7同类的圆圈都填7，与4同类的圆圈都填4。按图交替计数，两类各有12个圆圈，所以总和为12×7+12×4=12×11=132。
